root_cause: After exact production v183 source-parity, authorized pg_net request 1712 timed out at the outer HTTP 120-second budget. The engine subsequently wrote AI_TOOL_OUTPUT_MISSING at 15:35:54 UTC, after the prior 45-second AbortSignal issue was resolved. Existing model request still supplied eighty full signal records, thirty prior forecasts and twenty learnings while allowing up to six complex tool-use forecasts. Provider stop_reason was not recorded, so distinguish missing tool result from truncation or refusal via metadata before assigning a specific subcause.
